subject: SparkFlow: request for executive sanction on tiered hosted-rate concession
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@sparkflow.ai>
Date: 2027-08-02T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: SparkFlow: request for executive sanction on tiered hosted-rate concession

Mina —

Quick note on SparkFlow (SF-879). They want a committed 12‑month multiregion onramp and are asking for a 25% off hosted-API unit rate for the first 3 months to hit a usage milestone and justify a pilot. Key points:
- Forecasted first‑quarter usage ramp: 50M tokens/month -> 250M tokens/month by Q4 (see attached usage file).
- Strategic fit: SparkFlow is a channel partner candidate (co-marketing + marketplace pipeline).
- Competitive pressure: competitor XYZ has proposed heavy credits if we don’t match.

Impact/ask: Requesting senior exec sanction for an initial 25% concession (oversight: impacts net ARPU vs. baseline) for months 1–3, then revert to committed tier pricing. We need your signoff to move legal & finance quickly.

Attachments: sparkflow_usage_Q2.xlsx, sparkflow_MA P_draft.pdf

Next step I’m proposing: if approved, I’ll run the formal concession in Deal Desk, prepare DocuSign link, and propose a canary rollback clause if usage falls below threshold.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0113

--
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@sparkflow.ai>
Date: 2027-08-02T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SparkFlow: request for executive sanction on tiered hosted-rate concession

Ben —

Thanks for the summary. A few quick questions before I sign anything:
1) What’s the net revenue delta over 12 months at 25% vs. 22%? I want to understand the stretch.
2) Do we have SOC2 / contractual data residency notes on the MA P draft? Legal will want that spelled out for multiregion.
3) Is there an automatic rollback or performance clause so we don’t end up locked into an extended discount if they underdeliver?

I’m open to authorizing an interim sanction up to 22% for the first 3 months to accelerate contracting, but anything >22% needs CFO visibility. If you can get a short finance note and ensure security signoff in the thread, I’ll clear the 22% immediately.

Mina
Mina Haddad
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

--
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@sparkflow.ai>, legal@sparkflow.ai
Date: 2027-08-02T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SparkFlow: request for executive sanction on tiered hosted-rate concession

Mina —

Thanks — answered inline below and attaching a short finance calc.

1) Net revenue delta (attached redwood_pricing_impact_calc.csv): at 25% concession we see an ARR reduction of ~$120k over 12 months vs. baseline; at 22% the reduction is ~$95k. The 3% incremental discount costs roughly $25k ARR but materially increases likelihood of conversion to a 12‑month commit and marketplace listing (we’ve modeled a 30% higher conversion probability if we concede).
2) SOC2 / data residency: SparkFlow will host in AWS us-west and require a SOC2 attestation clause. Legal draft includes a standard SOC2 attestation reference + data processing addendum (attached PDF).
3) Rollback clause: Proposed clause in the MAP: if monthly tokens < 60% of forecast for two consecutive months, discount auto-reverts and we issue a usage true-up. I added that language in the draft MA P and highlighted it.

Elena — can you confirm the marketplace commitment and whether the co-marketing clause is firm? That’s the strategic upside Mina referenced.

If you’re good with those items, do you want to move forward with 22% for now and hold the 25% request pending CFO signoff (I can loop them if needed)?

Best,
Ben

Attachments: redwood_pricing_impact_calc.csv

--
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@sparkflow.ai>
Date: 2027-08-03T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SparkFlow: request for executive sanction on tiered hosted-rate concession

Mina / Ben —

Reviewed the numbers and legal draft. Finance comfortable with an interim executive sanction up to 22% for months 1–3 given the mitigations (rollback, true-up) and the ARR upside if conversion occurs. For anything >22% we require CFO notification and a brief one-page business case summarizing: incremental cost, conversion probability assumptions, and partner / marketplace commitments.

Mina — per your note, I recommend approving 22% now so contracting can move and we don’t lose momentum. If you approve, I’ll notify Deal Desk to author the concession and prepare the revenue recognition note for accounting.

Decision requested: Mina — please confirm approval ("Approve 22%" or "Escalate to CFO for 25%"), and I’ll action immediately.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
